notes: The upstream repository has no tagged release; the full commit and path-limited git archive hash define the implementation.
The archive contains unmodified DESCRIPTION, LICENSE.md, NAMESPACE, README.md, R/, man/, and the official vignette; upstream example data and rendered website assets are intentionally excluded.
The production wrapper calls the unmodified run_RUVIII function loaded from the locked core source.
The upstream core calls rsvd twice when constructing fullalpha; this wrapper preserves that behavior for source parity.
runtime_function_lock_note: Hashes cover the formals and bodies of every ruv/rsvd function reached by the locked numerical core.
